findings.summary: The Case 3 regularity condition and the phrase 'polynomially smaller/larger' are named but never defined, so a learner cannot check when Case 3 applies or tell Case 1 or 3 from the 'when it fails' gap.
findings.evidence: "Case 3 also needs the regularity condition on f(n)" and "Gaps like n log n against n: not polynomially different"
findings.fix: State the regularity condition (a·f(n/b) ≤ c·f(n) for some constant c < 1). Define 'polynomially smaller' as differing by a factor of n^ε for some ε > 0. Give one worked check, e.g. n log n vs n differs only by log n, which is not n^ε.
